title: Boyd Bushman talks antigravity

tellings.quote: I sit down and interview uh Boyd for a documentary I was making at the time called Ben Rich Secret.

plain: Nick Cook, a British aviation journalist, says he sat down to interview Boyd Bushman, an engineer at the aerospace company Lockheed Martin in Fort Worth, Texas, for a documentary he was making called Ben Rich Secret, named after a former Lockheed executive. According to Cook, Bushman talked about antigravity, which would mean someone has built machines that can push against gravity itself.
